import pathlib, tempfile, urllib.request, hashlib, json, struct, subprocess, datetime, sys, re
REPO=pathlib.Path('/mnt/c/laragon/www/mikpatch')
BASE=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='non-x86-inspection-',dir='/home/djundev/.cache/mikpatch-audit'))
def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def parts(b):
    assert struct.unpack_from('<I',b)[0]==0xbad0f11e
    assert struct.unpack_from('<I',b,4)[0]==len(b)-8
    p=8
    while p<len(b):
        typ,n=struct.unpack_from('<HI',b,p); p+=6
        assert p+n<=len(b)
        yield typ,b[p:p+n]; p+=n
    assert p==len(b)
report={'scope':'read-only static inspection; no signing, firmware edits, runtime or activation', 'base':str(BASE),'timestamp_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'head':'bb010811bd1443334ed32b0d3168ef09b77bc111','packages':[], 'preserved_files':{p:sha((REPO/p).read_bytes()) for p in ['patch.py','npk.py','.github/workflows/patch7.yml','docs/HANDOFF.md','docs/patch-coverage.md','terminal_banner.py','tests/test_terminal_banner.py']}}
(BASE/'inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
print('scratch',BASE,flush=True)
for arch in ['arm64','arm','mipsbe','mmips','smips','ppc']:
    url=f'https://download.mikrotik.com/routeros/7.24.4/routeros-7.24.4-{arch}.npk'
    rec={'arch':arch,'url':url,'signature_verified':False}; report['packages'].append(rec)
    try:
        req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'read-only-package-inspection/1.0'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=90) as r:
            rec['effective_url']=r.url; rec['http_status']=r.status; b=r.read()
        dest=BASE/arch; dest.mkdir(); (dest/'official.npk').write_bytes(b)
        rec.update(size=len(b),sha256=sha(b))
        sq=[v for t,v in parts(b) if t==0x15]; assert len(sq)==1
        (dest/'system.squashfs').write_bytes(sq[0]); rec['squashfs_sha256']=sha(sq[0]); rec['squashfs_size']=len(sq[0])
        rec['files']=[]
        for name in ['keyman','mode','loader']:
            r=subprocess.run(['unsquashfs','-cat',str(dest/'system.squashfs'),'nova/bin/'+name],capture_output=True)
            f={'path':'nova/bin/'+name,'extract_rc':r.returncode}; rec['files'].append(f)
            if r.returncode==0:
                (dest/name).write_bytes(r.stdout); f.update(size=len(r.stdout),sha256=sha(r.stdout))
        print(arch,'download/extract complete',rec['size'],flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
        rec['error_type']=type(e).__name__; print(arch,'incomplete',type(e).__name__,flush=True)
    (BASE/'inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

preservation_concurrency_note: Workflow patch7.yml changed concurrently by another worker/parent (banner flag and six-archive validation), not this investigator. Existing configured public role verified equal to baseline HEAD; no key change.
methodology_corrections: Initial instruction candidate search was heuristic only. Exact findings require complete32-byte or complete10-limb equality, then independently decoded raw fields.
ARM64 anchor envelopes include a call between two early callee-saved literal loads and subsequent stores. Full alias/ABI/control-flow proof not completed.
MIPS final SW occurs in JAL delay slot; scanner is not a safe generic linear matcher.
Individual key word or limb constants are never counted as anchors.
An exploratory summary command failed with NameError; no findings derive from that command.
Initial five incomplete loader findings were later resolved as ten-limb representations, including ARM arithmetic-derived limb8.
download_provenance_note: All six fresh full-body downloads returned HTTP200 from recorded official HTTPS URLs with no URL change; local SHA256 recorded. No signed vendor checksum/signature validation performed.
replacement_evidence: Exact original anchor representation identified in18/18 target binaries (13 raw32 reconstructed buffers and5 canonical10-limb buffers). ZERO replacement transformations generated or applied. Deterministic extraction is proven for these pinned samples; generic safe replacement remains proposal pending parent review.
